incident.error: Stage PROVISION_LICENSE failed: LICENSE_KEY placeholder replacement failed — .env may be malformed
incident.root_cause: Not a release 281 regression (the LICENSE_KEY=__LICENSE_KEY__ template line was unchanged). Since 67cb40ed (2026-06-29) ProvisionLicenseStage takes the key from LicenseServerService::issue(), which returns XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, but it verified the write with grep '^LICENSE_KEY=CIE-' (the pre-June format), so the check failed even when sed had replaced the placeholder. PROVISION_LICENSE had 0 completions since 2026-06-29; installation 52 was the first installation to reach it.

theme_access.finding: Master themes have no site/vertical/licence scoping: ADR-087 (AssetRef::KINDS = template, widget) governs library templates and widgets only. GET /api/theme-marketplace lists every is_marketplace + published + commercially eligible theme to every tenant, and initiatePurchase grants a free self-service licence when marketplace_price = 0. SolarIndustryThemeSeeder set is_marketplace=true, price 0 (and re-set it on every re-run).
